tools.name: docuflex_overview
tools.description: Product summary, how to get an API key, base URLs, auth, limits and links.

tools.name: docuflex_api_reference
tools.description: List the operations (method, path, summary) for one resource group from the OpenAPI spec: envelopes, signing, verify, templates, bulk-send, connect, uploads, api-keys, oauth, accounts, library, admin.

tools.name: esign_law_lookup
tools.description: High-level ESIGN / UETA / ESRA summary for a US state, the document types the federal act excludes, and what Docuflex records. Not legal advice.

tools.name: whoami
tools.description: Works with an OAuth2 bearer token (user principal). Plain API keys are account-scoped and get 403 here; then use the account id from Account settings in the Docuflex app and pass it as account_id or x-docuflex-account.

tools.name: create_envelope
tools.description: Create a Docuflex envelope. documents: inline base64 PDFs or staged uploadIds. recipients: name, email, routingOrder (1 = first), optional type (signer default, cc, certified_delivery, in_person_signer...). tabs: type (signature, initial, date_signed, text, checkbox...), page (1-based), x/y/width/he

tools.name: void_envelope
tools.description: Void a sent envelope with a reason.

tools.name: list_envelopes
tools.description: Most recent envelopes for the account.

tools.name: get_signing_url
tools.description: Short-lived signing URL for a current-tier recipient (embedded signing). Provide the recipient's email or clientUserId as used on the envelope and a returnUrl.

tools.name: get_audit_trail
tools.description: Hash-chained audit events for an envelope, oldest first.

tools.name: verify_envelope
tools.description: No key needed. Returns status, sealed-document hashes, certificate hash and audit-chain verification for an envelope id. Never returns document content.

tools.name: request_access
tools.description: Send a message to the Docuflex team (commercial terms, higher limits, questions). Only when the user explicitly asks and provides their own email. Limited to 5 per hour per IP.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "whoami" references sensitive artifacts (bearer). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: docuflex_overview, get_signing_url · Private data: docuflex_overview, esign_law_lookup, whoami, create_envelope, get_envelope, verify_envelope · Public sink: docuflex_api_reference, create_envelope, send_envelope, get_signing_url, request_access.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: docuflex_overview, get_signing_url · Private data: docuflex_overview, esign_law_lookup, whoami, create_envelope, get_envelope, verify_envelope · Public sink: docuflex_api_reference, create_envelope, send_envelope, get_signing_url, request_access

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
